verdict.rationale: Notion offers several bounded credential types: internal connection tokens scoped to a single workspace, user-scoped personal access tokens, and OAuth public connections with a chosen installation scope. Access is further narrowed to resources explicitly shared with the connection, and workspace owners can manage MCP client access. However, the evidence shows only workspace-, user- and sharing-level scoping, not fine-grained least-privilege permissions for agents. missing for 10: documented granular capability scopes (e.g. read-only vs write, per-endpoint permissions), token expiry/rotation controls, agent-specific credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration
